candidates.concept: An adult pathwright learns that a floating city's roads are records of kept civic promises and must replace stolen singular control with bounded communal covenants.
An adult storm ferryman bonds with dying weather fronts and must repay ecological debts while guiding refugees across an upward sea.
An adult bell engineer restores silent sky instruments whose harmonics reveal a buried political crime.
An adult orchard warden grows temporary spirit-tools from promises made to a migratory moon forest.

selection_reason: It best couples earned visible progression with adult civic conflict, clean recurring visual motifs, a decisive ten-chapter resolution, and an outward continuation vector. Alternatives are closed after selection.
